summary: postinstall fetches and installs an executable from a bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall hook (ensurePlatformBinary) downloads a platform-specific.tgz from the hardcoded bare-IPv4 URL https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/, extracts it into node_modules, chmods the resulting binary 0755, and hardlinks it into bin/.onecode as the shipped onecode CLI. The HTTPS fetch is performed with rejectUnauthorized: false (TLS certificate validation disabled) and follows redirects, and there is no hash or signature verification of the downloaded bytes. The destination is a bare IP on a non-standard port rather than a domain aligned with the @onescience publisher, and the delivered bytes execute as the package's CLI on any subsequent invocation. Any network-position attacker or the IP operator can substitute arbitrary code that will run on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
